title: Delaunay-type interface in a screened model of diblock copolymer melts
summary: A diblock copolymer is a soft-matter composed of two chemically distinct block of repeating monomers covalently bonded together at an end-to-end junction to form a single polymer chain. In this paper, we establish the existence of infinitely many smooth periodic unbounded domain patterns of Delaunay-type in $\mathbb{R}^3$ that optimize the energy distribution in diblock copolymer melts.
